title: Transuranic Synthesis
description: Beyond uranium every element is made: a nucleus is fed neutrons until it beta-decays up the table - plutonium, americium, curium, californium. Unlocks Californium-252.

puzzle.goal: N nuclei of a sample with half-life τ are left to wait a time t. Write how many n are left.
puzzle.name: Radioactive decay law
puzzle.ask: Find n for N = @{N} nuclei of californium-252 (T = @{T} years) after t = @{t} years.
puzzle.method: Every half-life halves what is left: after t/τ of them, N is divided by 2 that many times.
